defs.def: not very large, expensive, important, etc. 些许的；不太大（或贵、重要等）的

ex.s: You should remain modest when approaching perfection.
ex.t: 在趋近完美时，你应当保持谦虚。

ex.s: Having devoted himself to a third edition of The English-Chinese Dictionary after his retirement, Lu continued to edit the dictionary on the dining table of his modest Shanghai apartment.
ex.t: 退休后，陆谷孙全身心投入《英汉大词典》第三版的编纂，在他上海简陋公寓的餐桌上继续编辑词典。

defs.def: not talking much about your own abilities or possessions 谦虚的；谦逊的

ex.s: Modestly, so as not to become discouraged.
Mark Waitrose is a 1 modest and 2 especially talented man.
ex.t: 马克\u00b7维特罗斯是一个______谦虚且______特别有才华的人。

ex.s: It is also better to eat a modest amount of food each time, rather than to eat a lot in one meal, and then a little in the next.
ex.t: 每餐吃适量也更好，而不是一顿吃很多，下一顿又吃很少。

ex.s: Yet inside the hidden courtyards of Xi San Suo, there is something timeless about the way Mr Wang and his colleagues sedately piece together the past with skilful hands and modest hearts.
ex.t: 然而在西三所隐秘的庭院深处，王先生和他的同事们以灵巧的双手和谦逊的心平静地拼接过去的方式，有着一种超越时间的永恒。

defs.def: shy about showing much of the body; not intended to attract attention, especially in a sexual way 人，尤指妇女或其衣着
